records.context: Seeding one cell from every nucleus (:func:`cells_from_nucleus_seeds`) keeps the second nucleus of a cell that the cell model merged, but it also gives every small fragment of a nucleus its own cell. This step executes on the nucleus labels of a whole site, before the cells are seeded, so that every later step sees the merged nuclei.

This step runs on the nucleus labels of a whole site, before the cells are seeded, so that every later step sees the merged nuclei.
records.translation: Að sá einni frumu út frá hverjum kjarna (:func:`cells_from_nucleus_seeds`) heldur seinni kjarna frumu sem frumulíkanið sameinaði, en það gefur líka hverju litlu broti kjarna sína eigin frumu. Þetta skref keyrir á kjarnamerkjum heils svæðis, áður en frumunum er sáð, svo að hvert síðara skref sjái sameinuðu kjarnana.

records.context: The threshold is ``frac`` times the median area of the site's nuclei, measured before any merge. A nucleus below it that shares a border with another nucleus (pixel pairs in 4-connectivity) is merged into the neighbour with which it shares the longest border; ties go to the larger neighbour, then to the lower label. When that neighbour is itself small and merged, the chain is followed to the kept nucleus it ends on; two small pieces that choose each other end on the larger one. A small piece that touches no nucleus is kept: the step merges and never deletes. The labels are then renumbered 1..n in the order of their old labels, so the result is deterministic.
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.merge_small_nuclei#2
records.source: The threshold is ``frac`` times the median area of the site's nuclei, measured before any merge. A nucleus below it that shares a border with another nucleus (pixel pairs in 4-connectivity) is merged into the neighbour with which it shares the longest border; ties go to the larger neighbour, then to the lower label. When that neighbour is itself small and merged, the chain is followed to the kept nucleus it ends on; two small pieces that choose each other end on the larger one. A small piece that touches no nucleus is kept: the step merges and never deletes. The labels are then renumbered 1..n in the order of their old labels, so the result is deterministic.
records.translation: Þröskuldurinn er ``frac`` sinnum miðgildi flatarmáls kjarna svæðisins, mælt fyrir nokkra sameiningu. Kjarni undir honum sem á sameiginleg mörk við annan kjarna (pixlapör í 4-tengni) er sameinaður þeim nágranna sem hann á lengst sameiginleg mörk við; við jafntefli ræður stærri nágranninn, síðan lægra merkið. Þegar sá nágranni er sjálfur lítill og sameinaður er keðjunni fylgt að þeim varðveitta kjarna sem hún endar á; tvö lítil brot sem velja hvort annað enda á því stærra. Litlu broti sem snertir engan kjarna er haldið: skrefið sameinar og eyðir aldrei. Merkin eru síðan endurtölusett 1..n í röð gömlu merkjanna, svo niðurstaðan er ákvarðanleg.

records.context: Nuclei are segmented on the DNA image data channel, cells on ``cell_channels`` (Phalloidin, then DNA), each normalised once on the whole site (:func:`normalize_site`) and tiled by :func:`segment_tiled` on Cellpose's network grid, with the microscope image fields' flows stitched and Cellpose's mask step run once on the whole site (nuclei only without a diameter, since a diameter resizes each microscope image field). With ``seg_merge_small_nuclei_frac`` above 0 (default 0.25), nucleus pieces smaller than that fraction of the site's median nucleus area are then merged into the nucleus they touch (:func:`merge_small_nuclei`). With ``seg_cells_from_nucleus_seeds`` (default on) one cell is grown from every nucleus inside the cell network's foreground (:func:`cells_from_nucleus_seeds`), so a cell outline that holds two nuclei no longer loses one; with it off, the cells are the cell model's own masks. Then each nucleus is paired with one cell by :func:`spacr.ops_sample.pair_nuclei_with_cells` (cells without a nucleus are dropped, as in the OPS phenotype path).
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.segment_cell_painting_site#1
records.source: Nuclei are segmented on the DNA channel, cells on ``cell_channels`` (Phalloidin, then DNA), each normalised once on the whole site (:func:`normalize_site`) and tiled by :func:`segment_tiled` on Cellpose's network grid, with the tiles' flows stitched and Cellpose's mask step run once on the whole site (nuclei only without a diameter, since a diameter resizes each tile). With ``seg_merge_small_nuclei_frac`` above 0 (default 0.25), nucleus pieces smaller than that fraction of the site's median nucleus area are then merged into the nucleus they touch (:func:`merge_small_nuclei`). With ``seg_cells_from_nucleus_seeds`` (default on) one cell is grown from every nucleus inside the cell network's foreground (:func:`cells_from_nucleus_seeds`), so a cell outline that holds two nuclei no longer loses one; with it off, the cells are the cell model's own masks. Then each nucleus is paired with one cell by :func:`spacr.ops_sample.pair_nuclei_with_cells` (cells without a nucleus are dropped, as in the OPS phenotype path).
records.translation: Kjarnar eru bútaðir á DNA-rásinni og frumur á ``cell_channels`` (Phalloidin, síðan DNA), hvort um sig staðlað einu sinni yfir allt svæðið (:func:`normalize_site`) og skipt í flísar af :func:`segment_tiled` á netkerfisneti Cellpose, þar sem flæði flísanna eru skeytt saman og grímuskref Cellpose keyrt einu sinni á allt svæðið (kjarnar aðeins án þvermáls, þar sem þvermál breytir stærð hverrar flísar). Með ``seg_merge_small_nuclei_frac`` yfir 0 (sjálfgefið 0.25) eru kjarnabrot sem eru minni en það hlutfall af miðgildi kjarnaflatarmáls svæðisins síðan sameinuð kjarnanum sem þau snerta (:func:`merge_small_nuclei`). Með ``seg_cells_from_nucleus_seeds`` (sjálfgefið á) er ein fruma ræktuð út frá hverjum kjarna innan forgrunns frumunetsins (:func:`cells_from_nucleus_seeds`), svo að frumuútlína sem geymir tvo kjarna missir ekki lengur annan þeirra; sé það af eru frumurnar eigin grímur frumulíkansins. Síðan er hver kjarni paraður við eina frumu með :func:`spacr.ops_sample.pair_nuclei_with_cells` (frumum án kjarna er sleppt, eins og í OPS-svipgerðarleiðinni).

records.context: Writes, under ``seg_dst``: ``labels/<site>_nuclei.npy`` and ``labels/<site>_cells.npy``, ``tables/<site>_cells.parquet`` (one row per cell, measured by :func:`measure_chunked`), ``sites.csv`` (per site: objects, edge counts, the agreement with ``seg_report_reference`` when given, peak memory, seconds, where the whole-site mask step ran: :func:`summarise_mask_steps`, and, when ``seg_merge_small_nuclei_frac`` is above 0, ``merged_small_nuclei`` and ``median_nucleus_area_px``), ``mask_step.json`` (every mask step's note, per site and for the survey and the control), ``agreement_well.csv``, ``settings.json``, ``nucleus_diameter.json`` (the diameter, whether it was fixed or estimated, and the survey it came from) and, with ``seg_tiling_control_px``, ``tiling_control.json`` (:func:`tiling_control` on a centred region of the control site's cell image data channels, sized by :func:`control_layout`). The nucleus diameter, when not fixed, and the tiling-control site come from ``seg_diameter_sites`` sites spread over the microplate sample position, of which only those with at least ``seg_diameter_min_objects`` nuclei count (:func:`survey_sites`), never from one site that may be empty. With ``ops_mask_agreement_split_merge`` or ``ops_mask_agreement_identity_control`` (item 956), the saved labels are also scored against ``seg_report_reference`` into ``mask_agreement.csv``: one row per site and kind, with split and merge counts, F1 at IoU 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7, the identity and displaced controls, and a pooled row per kind with site-bootstrap 95 % CIs. With ``ops_mask_agreement_labels`` nothing is segmented: the labels saved there are scored and only ``mask_agreement.csv`` and ``settings.json`` are written.

records.translation: Skrifar undir ``seg_dst``: ``labels/<site>_nuclei.npy`` og ``labels/<site>_cells.npy``, ``tables/<site>_cells.parquet`` (ein lína á hverja frumu, mæld með :func:`measure_chunked`), ``sites.csv`` (fyrir hvert svæði: hlutir, jaðartölur, samræmið við ``seg_report_reference`` þegar það er gefið, hámarksminni, sekúndur, hvar grímuskref alls svæðisins keyrði: :func:`summarise_mask_steps`, og, þegar ``seg_merge_small_nuclei_frac`` er yfir 0, ``merged_small_nuclei`` og ``median_nucleus_area_px``), ``mask_step.json`` (athugasemd hvers grímuskrefs, fyrir hvert svæði og fyrir úrtakið og prófið), ``agreement_well.csv``, ``settings.json``, ``nucleus_diameter.json`` (þvermálið, hvort það var fast eða metið, og úrtakið sem það kom úr) og, með ``seg_tiling_control_px``, ``tiling_control.json`` (:func:`tiling_control` á miðjusettu svæði frumurása prófsvæðisins, af stærð sem :func:`control_layout` ákveður). Kjarnaþvermálið, þegar það er ekki fast, og svæði flísaprófsins koma frá ``seg_diameter_sites`` svæðum sem dreifast um brunninn, og af þeim teljast aðeins þau sem hafa minnst ``seg_diameter_min_objects`` kjarna (:func:`survey_sites`), aldrei frá einu svæði sem gæti verið tómt. Með ``ops_mask_agreement_split_merge`` eða ``ops_mask_agreement_identity_control`` (atriði 956) eru vistuðu merkin líka borin saman við ``seg_report_reference`` og skrifuð í ``mask_agreement.csv``: ein röð fyrir hvert svæði og hverja tegund hluta, með fjölda klofninga og samruna, F1 við IoU 0.3, 0.5 og 0.7, sjálfsmyndar- og hliðrunarviðmiðunum, og ein samlögð röð fyrir hverja tegund með 95 % öryggisbilum úr endurúrtaki svæða (bootstrap). Með ``ops_mask_agreement_labels`` er ekkert bútað: merkin sem þar eru vistuð eru metin og aðeins ``mask_agreement.csv`` og ``settings.json`` eru skrifuð.
